title: Winey Velvety Argentinian Samphire Empanadas
description: A crowd-pleaser featuring samphire, confit-tomato, and an Ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly twist. These empanadas are perfect for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: ayurvedic salt
ingredients.notes2: for seasoning empanadas, not regular salt

instructions: Combine 300g of the flour, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl.
Mix the wet ingredients and add them to the dry ingredients.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly.
Place a tablespoon of the samphire and confit tomato mixture in the center of each flattened dough circle.
Fold the dough in half to form a half-moon shape, and press the edges together to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with melted chicken fat and red wine.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the empanadas with additional melted chicken fat for a golden glaze.
Bake the empanadas in a preheated oven at 200°C for 25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Serve warm with a side of salsa criolla or chimichurri.
For the confit tomato, heat 100g of olive oil in a pan over medium heat.
Add a minced onion and sauté until translucent.
Add a minced garlic clove and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with cumin, salt, and black pepper to taste.
Let cool before using in the empanada filling.
For the samphire, chop it into 2.5cm pieces and sauté in a pan with 20g of olive oil until tender.
Season with salt, black pepper, and a pinch of cumin.
Let cool before using in the empanada filling.
